speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms; to pinpoint the cause, have you noticed any specific triggers for the itching, such as exposure to certain substances or seasonal changes?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: The rash affects your upper body and face, and you've been farming rice and caring for livestock for a year. Have you noticed if the rash gets worse when you are sweating or exposed to sunlight, and do you see any scaling or blisters?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease).

The combination of a pruritic rash on the face and upper body, numbness/tingling in the palms, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, and hypopigmented macules is highly specific for leprosy. I will proceed with confirmation testing.
